def make(h,w,starts_r,starts_c,size,ordinary,marks):
    g=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for i,r0 in enumerate(starts_r):
      for j,c0 in enumerate(starts_c):
        for dy in range(size):
          for dx in range(size):
            r,c=r0+dy,c0+dx
            if r<h and c<w:
              g[r][c]=ordinary if dy in (0,size-1) or dx in (0,size-1) else marks[i][j]
    return g

def ref(g, starts_r, starts_c, size, ordinary):
    o=[r[:] for r in g]
    # connect each nonordinary color on matching relative interior tracks.
    for dy in range(1,size-1):
      for dx in range(1,size-1):
        for ri,r0 in enumerate(starts_r):
          cells=[(r0+dy,c0+dx,g[r0+dy][c0+dx]) for c0 in starts_c if r0+dy<len(g) and c0+dx<len(g[0])]
          for color in set(v for _,_,v in cells if v!=ordinary):
            ps=[c for _,c,v in cells if v==color]
            for a,b in zip(ps,ps[1:]):
              for c in range(a+1,b):
                if o[r0+dy][c]==0:o[r0+dy][c]=color
        for ci,c0 in enumerate(starts_c):
          cells=[(r0+dy,c0+dx,g[r0+dy][c0+dx]) for r0 in starts_r if r0+dy<len(g) and c0+dx<len(g[0])]
